data.name: Soul Hunter
data.detailed_description:
Soul Hunter is a 4-player, online co-op, psychological horror game. You and your team of young paranormal researchers throw into the most mysterious and cursed places in Japan to prove the existence of the otherworld.

The only way to defeat the spirits is to capture them with a camera. In addition to sealing away the evil ghosts that attack you, the camera also serves as a charm against the evil eye, allows you to see through false illusions, and helps in the search for cursed objects.

GAMEPLAY

  •  “Soul Collector” Camera: This is your main tool and the only way to fight. The special camera is capable of repelling  vengeful ghosts, sealing away their powers, and capturing them. It is also used as a charm against the evil eye, helps you see through false illusions, and allows you to find cursed objects invisible to the naked eye.

  • Sanity: Keep an eye on your sanity. The longer you stay in a cursed area, the faster you’ll lose your mind. Better stock up on calming pills.

  • Exorcism: Only after performing a special ritual it is possible to fully exorcise the ghost. For each ghost, you must find and destroy all three of its cursed artifacts 

MULTIPLAYER

  • Cooperative play: Join forces with friends in this co-op horror game for a team of up to 4 people, where smooth collaboration is key to survival and success.

MAKE YOUR CHOICE

  • Explore the zones: The atmosphere here is truly oppressive. Dark abandoned buildings, the creak of wood, whispers, and voices from the void… definitely not for the faint of heart.

  • Bestiary: Each session is unique. You will encounter different creatures, each with its own special abilities and history. 

  • RPG elements: Play as one of the 4 researchers. Each has his own story and motive for participating in this expedition.

data.short_description: A team of young paranormal researchers ventures into the cursed corners of Japan to prove the existence of the spirit world. Ghosts feed on fear and the sanity of the living, luring you into traps of illusion. Your only defense is a special camera, capable of banishing spirits and unveiling secrets.
